name: Brand kit prompt guide
description: The brand kit prompt from the reel: upload one photo of your product to ChatGPT and get a brand board with a name, a logo, five colours, two fonts, your product with the new label, packaging and a lifestyle photo. One follow-up makes your listing photos.

page.title: One photo of your product, a whole brand
page.sub: One free prompt for ChatGPT from the reel. Photograph what you sell, upload it, and get a brand board: a name and a logo, five colours with their codes, two fonts, your own product with the new label on it, a packaging mock-up and a photo for social media. Ask once more and it makes the photos you need to sell it online.
page.prompt_how: Upload one clear photo of your product to a normal ChatGPT chat (not a temporary chat: those can't make images) and paste this under it. Change the parts in square brackets first.
page.prompt_note: A plain photo is fine. Ours was a candle on a kitchen table.
page.tested_title: We ran it ourselves, on a plain candle

results.name: A name and a logo, on one board
Five colours with their hex codes, and two fonts
Our own jar with the new label, and a gift box
Four listing photos from one follow-up
Whether the name is free to use: we did not check

page.tested_text: We uploaded a photo of a plain candle with a blank label and pasted the prompt. One image came back with all six parts: a name and logo (it invented "Emberwood Candle Co."), **five colours with hex codes**, **two fonts** (Playfair Display and Inter), **our own jar with the new label**, a kraft gift box and a lifestyle shot. One follow-up ("Now make the photos I need to sell it online…") returned **four listing photos**: white background, bedside table, in a hand, a close-up. **To be clear:** the candle photo was made with AI, so no real brand is in the reel. **Not checked:** whether anyone already trades under the name it invented. It also wrote "sandalwood & cedar" on the label, which was its guess.
page.tip: **The tip:** tell it the true details (the scent, the weight, the material) in the first bracket, or it will make them up for the label.

prompt:
This is a photo of my product, [what it is]. Build a complete brand around it and show it as ONE brand board image on an off-white background, laid out as a clean grid with a small label on each part:
1) a brand name you invent and a simple logo,
2) a palette of five colours with their hex codes,
3) the two fonts to use,
4) my product re-shot as a professional pack shot with the new label and logo on it,
5) a packaging mock-up,
6) one lifestyle photo for social media.

Keep my real product: the same [jar / bottle / item], the same shape and size. The feel: [three words, for example premium, minimal, warm]. Vertical 3:4.

followups.label: The listing photos
followups.prompt: Now make the photos I need to sell it online, as ONE image split into four equal squares with a thin white gap: 1) the product on a pure white background, straight on, 2) in use at home in warm light, 3) held in one hand to show its size, 4) a close-up of the label. Same product, label and logo as the brand board. Square 1:1.
followups.note: This is the follow-up we tested.

followups.label: Three names to choose from
followups.prompt: Give me three different brand names and logos for the same product, side by side on one board, each with one line on who it is for.
followups.note: Then check the one you like is free to use.

followups.label: The words too
followups.prompt: Write the product title, five bullet points and a 60-word description for a listing, using only these true facts: [your facts]. No claims I have not given you.
followups.note: For Etsy, Amazon or your own shop.

checklist.title: Photograph your product
checklist.detail: One clear photo. The background doesn't matter.

checklist.title: Upload it to ChatGPT
checklist.detail: A normal chat, then paste the prompt under the photo.

checklist.title: Fill in the true details
checklist.detail: What it is, what it is made of, and three words for the feel.

checklist.title: Ask for the listing photos
checklist.detail: Use the first follow-up. It keeps the same label and logo.

checklist.title: Check the name
checklist.detail: Search the name it invented before you print anything.

safety: **Check the name and logo are free to use.** It invents them, and someone may already trade under that name. Search it, and check trade marks where you sell.
**The pictures must match what you ship.** Marketplaces expect listing photos to show the real item. Use these as designs to produce, or re-shoot the real product once it has the new label.
**Only true claims.** It will write things on a label (a scent, "natural", a weight) that it made up. Replace them with your own.
